sections.title: Player text
sections.body: The home lowers, and from it steps a being seven feet tall: part humanoid, part firefly, moving in slow drifts broken by sudden jerky motions. Her face is hard to read, but her voice carries every feeling plainly. She eyes your group with open mischief. "Are you the group Emeris sent from the capital? Oh my. You are rather late, are you not? Come in, come in." Inside, the treehouse opens far larger than it should, packed with potion bottles, spellbooks, runes, plants, and small creatures. None of it is messy. You get the sense that if you moved a single item an inch, she would know.

Gmnotes: This scene is pure RP with stakes. Dice are optional; trust is not optional. Per-character hooks belong in perCharacterLayer, not in these notes.
Gmscript: Say: "She is warm, weird, ancient, and deciding right now who you are. She rewards honesty and curiosity. Meet her strangeness with warmth and she will meet yours."

Gmreadaloud: A seven-foot being steps from the hanging home: part humanoid, part firefly. Her face is hard to read, but her voice carries every feeling plainly. Inside, the treehouse opens far larger than it should.

Gmchecklist: Describe before naming: seven-foot firefly-faerie first, Whitefire Custodian after she names herself. Ask about the journey, who sent them, and how they imagine they might die. Read hush_trust, bramble_truth_learned, strixwolf_blood_debt, and custodian_route. Set custodian_trust from warmth, honesty, restraint, and answers. Do not reveal the package truth until S04-04.

Gmprivate: Her knowledge stance is a Kyle canon flag. Play her as warm and guarded; do not resolve whether she fully knows the ward cost. If strixwolf_blood_debt is true, she can gently name that the forest has been watching the party with teeth.
Playertakeaway: Be genuine with her and she becomes your greatest ally; be cold and she gives only what she must.
Storytakeaway: The person the job served is strange, ancient, warm, and bound to the safety everyone has been circling.
Mechanictakeaway: custodian_trust is the mechanic: warmth, honest answers, restraint, and curiosity decide how much candor and help she gives.

Every act offers at least one guaranteed and one earned hint that the danger is manufactured and the forest is not the enemy. The sealed package is the capital's ward Keystone; the city is unwarded while it is away. KEEP GUARANTEED "The wood never needed managing. It needed leaving alone." Takeawayhelp: Player takeaway Be genuine with her and she becomes your greatest ally. "She rewards honesty and curiosity. Meet her strangeness with warmth and she will meet yours." "Answer her questions, ask about her home or the town, or simply be kind to the odd old faerie. She is listening." The table action is conversation. Make each answer matter by changing her warmth, not by demanding a roll. presence knowledge table-spotlight Story takeaway The job recipient is strange, ancient, warm, and bound to the safety everyone has been circling. "She is warm, weird, and older than she looks, and she is deciding right now who you are." "She can name herself as the Whitefire Custodian. Her deeper nature is visible through her home, not explained all at once." Keep the package truth out of this scene. Let trust and curiosity earn the next scene. presence knowledge table-spotlight Mechanic takeaway custodian_trust is the mechanic. "No dice needed unless you want them. Just talk. Her trust is the live counter here." "Warmth, honesty, restraint, and thoughtful answers raise trust. Transactional coldness or theft lowers it." The payoff is S04-04 and Act 5: trust changes candor, help, and ritual...
